versions.content: Definition of API function Rte_StartTiming Service Name Rte_StartTiming Syntax void Rte_StartTiming ( void ) Service ID [hex] 0x76 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) None Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description Rte_StartTiming API is intended to release the activation of RunnableEntitys triggered by TimingEvents and BackgroundEvents after the last call of a Rte_Init function. Available via Rte.h
